scope: Match Weight Configuration engine providing canonical presets (Balanced Default title:20, skills:25, experience:15, location:15, salary:10, education:5, company:5, industry:5; Technical Skills; Seniority/Experience; Remote/Compensation; Custom), mathematical normalization, adapter mapping to 12-dimension matching components, and MatchWeightConfiguration interactive UI component.

acceptance.canonical_preset: PASS; PRESET_BALANCED_DEFAULT reproduces the authoritative example (title 20, skills 25, experience 15, location 15, salary 10, education 5, company 5, industry 5) summing to 100.0%.
acceptance.multiple_models: PASS; supports multiple preset models rather than hardcoding a single model, plus flexible custom weighting.
acceptance.normalization_algorithm: PASS; normalize_weights scales arbitrary dimension weights to 100.0% preserving relative proportions and correcting rounding drift.
acceptance.component_weights_adapter: PASS; to_component_dimension_weights bridges 8-dimension user models into 12-dimension match components, dividing skills into required (65%) and preferred (35%).
acceptance.frontend_components: PASS; MatchWeightConfiguration renders preset dropdowns, per-dimension sliders, total weight balance gauges, auto-normalize action, and reset/save controls.
acceptance.safety: PASS; external submission OFF asserted; purely deterministic local calculations.

checks.target: Unit tests for preset models, normalization, validation, and adapter mapping
TypeScript check and Vite production client build
